Lilach Bullock: Is Notion AI free?

caption:
Notion AI is not really free: Free and Plus only get a trial of AI responses.
Full Notion AI, the Agent and AI Meeting Notes come with the $20 Business plan.
Here is how to use it, and how to make the trial last.

Would you pay $20 a month for AI inside your notes?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

slides.headline: How to use *Notion AI*, and what the free limit really is

slides.heading: 1. The free plan is *only a trial*
paras: Free and Plus get a limited number of AI responses. Every Try again counts as one more.
When they run out, Notion asks you to move to Business, which costs $20 per member a month.

slides.heading: 2. Ask the *Agent* to build
paras: Click the round face icon in the bottom right corner, or New chat in the sidebar.
Notion Agent can build a database, update pages and search connected apps like Slack and Google Drive.

slides.heading: 3. Type */meet* for meeting notes
paras: AI Meeting Notes transcribes a call, sums it up and lists the action items.
Type /meet on a page, click Start when the meeting begins and Stop when it ends.

slides.heading: 4. Check what it *writes*
paras: Slite's review warns that Notion AI can make things up when it expands text.
Read every draft before you share it, and give the Agent the pages it should use.

paragraphs.text: How to use Notion AI depends first on your plan. On Notion's Free and Plus plans, AI is a trial: you get a limited number of complimentary responses, and when they are gone Notion asks for an upgrade to Business or Enterprise. On Business, which Notion's pricing page lists at $20 per member a month, Notion AI, Notion Agent and AI Meeting Notes are included.
So treat the free responses as a test drive. Spend them on the jobs Notion AI does best, building structure and summarizing your own pages, rather than on small rewrites you could do yourself.
What counts toward the Notion AI free limit

Notion counts any AI action that returns a response: creating or editing content, using AI blocks, adding an autofill property to a database and asking a question. Clicking Try again counts as another response. Notion's help page does not say how many responses the trial includes. Only a workspace owner can upgrade, and the upgrade has to be done on desktop.

Lilach Bullock's guide, last updated November 9, 2026, notes that the Plus plan does not include full Notion AI either, despite costing money, and that AI image generation is limited to Business and Enterprise. Notion's pricing page lists Plus at $10 per member a month with the same AI trial as Free.
Write the full request in one message instead of retrying. A retry costs a response, and a clear first prompt usually saves two.
Step by step: your first Notion AI tasks

paragraphs.title: 1. Open Notion AI
paragraphs.text: Click the round face icon in the bottom right corner of your workspace, or select New chat in the sidebar. That opens a chat with Notion Agent.

paragraphs.title: 2. Use it while you write
paragraphs.text: Inside a page, Slite's guide lists three more ways in: highlight text and click Ask AI in the toolbar, type /AI on a new line, or press the space bar on an empty line.

paragraphs.title: 3. Decide whether it may search the web
paragraphs.text: Notion Agent can search your workspace and connected tools. Turn web search on when you want outside information, or off to keep it to your own docs.

paragraphs.title: 4. Ask it to build, not just write
paragraphs.text: The Agent can build databases, update pages and work through a task from start to finish. If the result misses, give it more context or ask it to adjust instead of starting over.

Notion's own Business trial guide describes the Agent this way: it searches across your workspace and connected tools, builds databases, updates pages and analyzes information. Its example prompts include building a project tracker with an owner, status, priority and deadline, and researching tips for social media posts and putting the hooks and call-to-action ideas into a database.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 1: Build a tracker
paragraphs.text: Build a project tracker database for [project]. Columns: task, owner, status (Not started, In progress, Done), priority, deadline and a checkbox to flag work that is at risk. Add three example rows I can delete.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 2: Summarize your own pages
paragraphs.text: Read the pages in [teamspace or page name] and write a one-page summary: the decisions made, open questions, and every action item with its owner. Use only what is in those pages and link to where each point came from.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 3: Turn messy notes into a plan
paragraphs.text: Turn the notes on this page into a plan with three sections: goals, steps with dates, and risks. Keep my wording where you can and mark anything you had to guess with [check].
How to use Notion AI Meeting Notes

AI Meeting Notes transcribes a meeting, summarizes the discussion and captures action items. Type /meet to add the block, or click the Meet pill on a new page. Click Start when the meeting begins and Stop when it ends. Meeting detection for Zoom and Google Meet can be turned on under Settings, then Notifications, and you can choose a meeting format, add an agenda and later ask the Agent about past meetings.

Speaker labels need extra setup: the Notion Meetings browser extension for Google Meet, or speaker names turned on in the desktop app for Zoom on Mac. On Notion's pricing page, AI Meeting Notes is part of Business and appears only as a limited trial on Free and Plus.
Connect your other apps

Connectors let Notion AI search outside Notion. You set them up under Settings, then Notion AI, approve the permissions and wait for the first indexing. Notion names Google Drive, Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub and Jira, and some connectors need an admin to set them up. Notion's pricing page lists Enterprise Search, the feature behind this, as a beta on Business.
Business trial credits and Custom Agents

Business trials that started on or after October 19, 2026 include 1,500 Standard and 500 Select AI credits a month, and extra credits cannot be bought during a trial. Custom Agents, which run on their own for a team, are free to try and then cost $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits, according to Notion's pricing page.
What Notion AI is bad at

Slite, which makes a competing product, lists the weak spots in its review: expanding text can produce made-up details, tone rewrites tend to flatten longer passages, answers are only as good as how current your pages and connectors are, and database AI struggles with free-text fields that need context beyond the row.

The pattern is simple. Notion AI is strongest when it works from pages you already wrote and weakest when it has to invent. Point it at your own material, ask for structure, and read the result before anyone else does.
